assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to correlate clinical events with arrhythmic activity during daily activities
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
The service is needed to capture rhythm data while monitoring for episodes associated with the documented diagnoses
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial states that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The clinical indication clearly supports coverage of diagnostic monitoring
